run_load_test: run the labgraph load test graph with default 30 second duration and dynamic size config
run_many_dynamic_sizes: run the load test across 21 dynamic sizes from 8 bytes to 8 megabytes using --many-dynamic-sizes flag
review_LoadTestPublisher: review the LoadTestPublisher node that publishes LoadTestSample messages at a high rate for a configured duration
review_LoadTestSubscriber: review the LoadTestSubscriber node that receives samples and logs latency, sample rate, and dropped sample statistics
review_LoadTest: review the LoadTest graph that connects a publisher and subscriber node for performance benchmarking
